$comment: Every model id the room uses, as <provider>/<model>, where provider is <harness>-<role>. Role prompts carry {{placeholders}} the plugin fills from this file when a seat is created, so a model change needs no prompt edit. Any harness can hold any role: a Codex Supervisor is seats.supervisor.provider = "codex-supervisor/<model>", a Claude-only Peer tier lists claude-peer models. Every provider named here must be enabled in paseo/seats.yml (install.sh checks). The values below are one author's setup, not a default of the room. modes: the Paseo session mode a seat is created in, per harness; null for a harness that has none (Pi), where passing any mode is refused.

default.use: implementation, debugging, multi-file changes with invariants, research with judgement
default.never: the review of a candidate a Claude Peer wrote

cross-family.use: the reviewer of a Claude-written candidate, a tie-break, a retry after a Claude Peer failed

lens.$comment: Lenses are not Peers: strong models that think independently for the Lead, from a neutral brief, without the Lead's judgement or context. One lens = the oracle, or `hard` when the question is hard. Two = the pair, which must be two different models. A third comes from pool; a pool entry that repeats a pair model puts a second lens on that model, on its own angle.
